BROOKLYN'S PREMIERE QUEER NIGHTCLUB, LIVE MUSIC & PERFORMANCE VENUE

260 Meserole Street Brooklyn, NY, 11206 United States

7183663031

We are very proud and excited to open our doors and welcome our community into a space that represents our commitment to inclusion and the celebration of queer identity. We are a space for joy. We open as the largest queer venue in Brooklyn, and we look forward to providing this unique outlet that will allow everyone to express themselves as their fullest, most genuine, selves. From fabulous nights at the bar to incredible events with amazing sound and lights, 3 Dollar Bill has arrived, and we’re ready to have a good time.
